name: Aegis Shockproof Cover for iPhone 15 Pro
shortDescription: Military-grade drop protection in a slim profile.
description: The Aegis cover wraps your iPhone 15 Pro in a precision-molded shell that survives drops up to 2.4m without adding bulk. Raised bezels protect the camera and screen, while a soft-touch grip keeps it steady in hand.
features: Precision cutouts for all ports and buttons

reviews.author: Aarav M.
reviews.title: Saved my phone twice already
reviews.comment: Dropped it on tile and on concrete, not a scratch on the phone. Buttons still feel clicky.

reviews.author: Nisha P.
reviews.title: Great fit, slightly thick
reviews.comment: Fits perfectly and camera bump is fully protected. A touch bulkier than my old case but worth it.

name: Clear Armor Cover for Galaxy S24 Ultra
shortDescription: Show off your phone's design without compromising protection.
description: A crystal-clear polycarbonate back paired with a shock-absorbing TPU frame. Anti-yellowing coating keeps it looking new for longer, and reinforced corners guard against everyday drops.

name: Pulse Air Wireless Earbuds
shortDescription: Active noise cancellation with 30-hour total battery life.
description: Pulse Air pairs deep, balanced sound with hybrid active noise cancellation. A compact charging case gives you six extra charges on the go, and touch controls put playback, calls and ANC one tap away.

reviews.author: Rohit S.
reviews.title: ANC actually works
reviews.comment: Used these on a flight, cut out most of the engine noise. Call quality is clear too.

reviews.author: Meera K.
reviews.title: Great value
reviews.comment: Sound is punchy, case fits in the smallest pocket. Wish the touch controls were a bit less sensitive.

name: Bassline Over-Ear Headphones
shortDescription: 40mm drivers and plush ear cushions for all-day listening.
description: Bassline delivers rich, room-filling sound from 40mm dynamic drivers, wrapped in memory-foam ear cushions built for long sessions. Foldable design and a 40-hour battery make it a natural travel companion.

name: Turbo 33W Fast Charger
shortDescription: 0–60% in around 30 minutes on supported phones.
description: Compact and pocketable, the Turbo 33W charger uses GaN technology to deliver fast, safe charging to phones, buds and tablets. Built-in surge protection keeps every device safe over the long run.
features: Compatible with USB-C laptops and tablets

reviews.author: Karan D.
reviews.title: Tiny but powerful
reviews.comment: Charges my phone almost as fast as the original brick, and it's half the size.

name: Dual-Port 65W GaN Charger
shortDescription: Charge a laptop and a phone at the same time.
description: 65W of shared power across two USB-C ports means you can top up a laptop and a phone simultaneously, without carrying two chargers. Foldable pins make it travel-ready.

name: Braided USB-C to USB-C Cable (1m)
shortDescription: Nylon-braided cable rated for 10,000+ bends.
description: A tangle-resistant nylon braid over a reinforced core makes this cable built to last. Supports 60W fast charging and full-speed data sync.

name: Braided Lightning Cable (1m)
shortDescription: MFi-style durability for daily charging.
description: A reinforced Lightning cable built with a woven nylon jacket to resist fraying at the connector, the most common failure point. Supports fast charging with compatible adapters.

name: Slimline 10,000mAh Power Bank
shortDescription: Credit-card slim, pocket-ready backup power.
description: At just 14mm thick, the Slimline power bank slips into any bag or pocket while still holding a full charge for most phones. Dual outputs let you charge two devices at once.

reviews.author: Divya R.
reviews.title: Perfect travel companion
reviews.comment: So thin it barely adds anything to my bag, but it fully charges my phone once with some left over.

name: Rugged 20,000mAh Power Bank
shortDescription: High capacity with a shockproof outdoor build.
description: Built for road trips and outdoor days, this rugged power bank packs 20,000mAh with a reinforced shell that shrugs off drops and dust. A built-in flashlight helps in a pinch.

name: Edge-to-Edge Tempered Glass for iPhone 15
shortDescription: 9H hardness glass with an oleophobic coating.
description: Precision-cut to the exact curve of the iPhone 15 display, this glass protector goes on bubble-free with the included alignment tray. An oleophobic coating resists fingerprints and smudges.

name: Privacy Tempered Glass for Galaxy S24 Ultra
shortDescription: Keep your screen private from side angles.
description: A privacy filter built into 9H tempered glass blacks out your screen for anyone viewing from the side, while staying perfectly clear head-on. Fingerprint sensor compatible.

name: Magnetic Dashboard Car Mount
shortDescription: One-hand mount and release, fits any dashboard.
description: A strong N52 magnet array holds your phone steady over bumps, while a flexible gooseneck lets you angle the screen exactly where you need it. Universal fit for any car and any phone.
features: Universal fit — any car, any phone

reviews.author: Sanjay V.
reviews.title: Rock solid on bad roads
reviews.comment: Been using this for 3 months on Pune's roads, phone hasn't budged once.

name: AC Vent Clip Phone Mount
shortDescription: Clips onto any AC vent in seconds.
description: A spring-loaded claw grip clips securely onto your AC vent and holds phones of any size, from compact phones to large phablets in a case.
features: Fits AC vents up to 8mm thick

name: Custom-Fit Dash Mount for Hyundai Creta
shortDescription: Purpose-built to the Creta's dashboard contour, no adhesive needed.
description: Molded specifically to the Hyundai Creta's dashboard trim, this mount slots into place without any adhesive or drilling, and holds your phone at the perfect driving angle.

name: Dual-Port Car Fast Charger
shortDescription: 38W of fast charging from your 12V socket.
description: A compact charger that fits flush in your car's 12V socket, delivering 38W across two ports so driver and passenger can charge together.

name: Wireless Charging Car Mount
shortDescription: Mount and charge wirelessly in one motion.
description: Auto-clamping arms sense your phone and close around it, while a 15W wireless coil starts charging instantly. Vent and dashboard mounting options are both included.

name: ClearDrive Full HD Dash Cam
shortDescription: 1080p recording with loop capture and night mode.
description: ClearDrive records crisp 1080p footage on a loop, automatically saving clips when it detects an impact. Enhanced night vision keeps footage clear after dark.

reviews.author: Anita J.
reviews.title: Caught the whole incident clearly
reviews.comment: Had a minor fender bender and the footage was sharp enough to settle it in minutes with insurance.

name: ClearDrive Dual-Lens Dash Cam
shortDescription: Front and rear recording in a single unit.
description: Cover both ends of your car with front and rear cameras recording simultaneously. A 2.4-inch display lets you review footage instantly, and parking mode watches your car while you're away.

name: Premium Backseat Organizer
shortDescription: Keep tablets, bottles and everyday essentials in reach.
description: Multiple padded pockets, a tablet holder and insulated cup slots turn the back of any seat into smart, tidy storage. Durable, wipeable fabric handles daily wear.

name: Custom-Fit Boot Mat for Tata Nexon
shortDescription: Laser-measured to the Nexon's exact boot dimensions.
description: Precision-molded to the Tata Nexon's boot floor, this all-weather mat protects against spills, mud and wear while sitting flush with no gaps.
features: Easy to lift out and hose down

name: Bluetooth FM Transmitter & Car Charger
shortDescription: Stream music and charge your phone from any car's 12V socket.
description: Bring Bluetooth audio and hands-free calling to any car radio built before smartphones existed. Plug into the 12V socket, pair your phone, and tune your radio to the built-in FM frequency.

reviews.author: Farhan K.
reviews.title: Old car, new tricks
reviews.comment: My 2012 sedan finally has Bluetooth audio. Setup took two minutes, sound is clear with minimal static.

name: Dual-Speaker Bluetooth Car Kit
shortDescription: Clip-on speakers for richer sound than a single transmitter.
description: Two compact speakers clip to your sun visors and pair over Bluetooth, delivering fuller sound and clearer calls than a single-point FM transmitter, with no wiring into the dashboard.

name: Rugged Armor Cover for OnePlus 12
shortDescription: Textured grip and reinforced corners for daily carry.
description: A dual-layer build pairs a rigid inner shell with a textured, grippy outer layer, so the OnePlus 12 stays secure in hand and protected at the corners where drops hit hardest.

name: Slim Silicone Cover for Pixel 8
shortDescription: Soft-touch silicone with a microfibre lining.
description: A liquid-silicone exterior feels soft against the hand while a microfibre lining keeps the inside scratch-free. Slim enough to keep the Pixel 8's design intact.

name: EchoBuds Lite Wireless Earbuds
shortDescription: Everyday true wireless earbuds at an easy price.
description: EchoBuds Lite covers the essentials well: clear calls, punchy sound and a pocket-sized case, without paying for features you won't use.

name: StudioMax ANC Headphones
shortDescription: Studio-tuned sound with adaptive noise cancellation.
description: StudioMax pairs adaptive ANC with a neutral, studio-leaning sound signature and 50-hour battery life, built for people who wear headphones most of the day.

name: Compact 20W PD Charger
shortDescription: A no-fuss single-port charger that fits any bag pocket.
description: For anyone who just needs a reliable fast charger without extra ports or bulk, this 20W PD adapter charges a phone quickly and takes up almost no space.

name: 4-Port Desktop Charging Station
shortDescription: Charge the whole household from one outlet.
description: Four independent ports with smart current allocation mean everyone's phone, tablet or earbuds case charges at its best possible speed, all from a single desktop station.

name: Braided USB-C to Lightning Cable (1m)
shortDescription: Fast-charge your iPhone from any USB-C charger.
description: Pairs any USB-C fast charger with Lightning-port iPhones, so you can use the same charger for your phone, laptop and earbuds case. Nylon braided for durability.
features: Fast charging with USB-C PD chargers

name: 3-in-1 Retractable Charging Cable
shortDescription: One cable, three connectors, zero tangles.
description: A retracting reel houses USB-C, Lightning and Micro-USB connectors in one cable, so a single travel pouch covers every device in the family.
features: USB-C, Lightning and Micro-USB in one

name: Wireless Power Bank 5,000mAh
shortDescription: Snaps on magnetically and charges without a cable.
description: A magnetic array aligns and holds this power bank to the back of compatible phones, delivering wireless charging on the go with no cable to carry.
features: Works best with iPhone 12 and later

name: Solar 25,000mAh Power Bank
shortDescription: Huge capacity with a solar panel for backup trickle charging.
description: Built for treks and long outdoor days, this power bank holds enough charge for a phone all week and tops itself up slowly via its built-in solar panel when you're off-grid.
features: Rugged, dust and splash resistant shell

name: Edge-to-Edge Tempered Glass for OnePlus 12
shortDescription: Full-coverage 9H glass for the OnePlus 12's curved display.
description: Shaped to match the OnePlus 12's display curve, this glass protector covers edge to edge without lifting, and includes an alignment tray for a bubble-free install.

name: Tempered Glass for Pixel 8
shortDescription: 9H hardness, precision cut for the Pixel 8.
description: A precision laser-cut glass protector that matches the Pixel 8's display exactly, keeping the in-display fingerprint sensor and Face Unlock fully working.

name: Custom-Fit Dash Mount for Mahindra XUV700
shortDescription: Molded to the XUV700's dashboard trim, no adhesive needed.
description: Shaped specifically for the Mahindra XUV700's dashboard contour, this mount clips into place without adhesive or drilling and holds your phone at a natural driving angle.

name: Wireless Charging Gravity Vent Mount
shortDescription: Clamps shut automatically under its own weight, charges wirelessly.
description: Gravity-actuated arms close around your phone the moment it's placed, no button needed, while a 10W wireless coil keeps it charged for the whole drive.

name: 65W PD Car Charger
shortDescription: Laptop-capable fast charging from your car's socket.
description: With 65W of Power Delivery, this car charger can top up a USB-C laptop as easily as a phone, making it a single charger for every device on a road trip.

name: Fast Charge Single-Port Car Charger
shortDescription: A simple, reliable charger for every car.
description: No frills, just a dependable 20W fast charger that fits any 12V socket and keeps a phone topped up on the commute.

name: Compact Mini Dash Cam
shortDescription: Discreet, budget-friendly recording for every drive.
description: Small enough to sit unnoticed behind your mirror, this mini dash cam still delivers clear 1080p loop recording with impact-triggered saving.

name: 4K Ultra HD Dash Cam with GPS
shortDescription: The sharpest footage in the lineup, with route logging.
description: 4K recording captures number plates and road signs with real clarity, while built-in GPS logs your speed and route alongside the footage for complete trip records.
features: Built-in GPS route and speed logging

name: Custom-Fit Floor Mats for Kia Seltos
shortDescription: Laser-measured to the Seltos's exact floor contours.
description: A precise, vehicle-specific fit means these mats sit flush with no gaps or curling, protecting the Seltos's floor from mud, spills and daily wear.
features: Easy to lift out and clean

name: Universal Steering Wheel Cover
shortDescription: A better grip and a refreshed interior in minutes.
description: A textured, breathable cover slips over any standard steering wheel to improve grip and hide wear, with an easy no-tools installation.

name: Car Bluetooth Speaker with FM
shortDescription: A dashboard speaker that beats your phone's tiny speaker.
description: Mounts to the dashboard or sun visor and pairs over Bluetooth, giving noticeably fuller sound and clearer hands-free calls than any phone speaker, plus a built-in FM tuner.

name: Dashboard-Mount Bluetooth Speakerphone
shortDescription: Built around hands-free calls, not just music.
description: Dual noise-cancelling microphones and a forward-facing speaker are tuned specifically for hands-free calls, so the other person hears you clearly over road and wind noise.
